capabilities: Generate tags for the current note with one click
Apply generated tags to note frontmatter
Reuse existing vault tags and avoid duplicates
extras: Quick Start Guide and Development Documentation are external links; prompts support Chinese and English.
intentEvidence: This project is forked from lucagrippa/obsidian-ai-tagger, with code updates and feature enhancements.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to suggest tags from note content, so users must invent and apply tags manually.

relations.evidence: This project is forked from lucagrippa/obsidian-ai-tagger, with code updates and feature enhancements.

summary: AI-powered plugin that analyzes Obsidian notes and generates up to five existing and three new tags in frontmatter with one click.
